'''Keta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] member of the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], she served as [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] aboard the ''[[Void Cutter]]''.
